title: Pin delta coalescer + tenant-SLA-aware eval dispatcher
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Goal: Implement a lightweight service that deduplicates and scores model-version pin events, coalesces frequent pin churn, and dispatches tenant-priority, SLA-aware eval triggers with budget/cost constraints. This avoids noisy/full-fanout evals for rapid authoring changes while guaranteeing high-priority tenants and critical catalog upgrades receive timely, well-sampled regression checks.

Scope:
- Event deduper + delta calculator: compute semantic delta between old/new model/config (size, quantization, tokenizer, hyperparams) and assign an urgency score.
- Tenant SLA sampling reservoir: per-tenant budget and SLA profile (latency/quality sensitivity) to decide sampling weight.
- Dispatch queue with backpressure: emit eval run requests to the eval-orchestrator with priority hints and cost caps; coalesce events within a configurable window (default 5m).
- Safeguards: maximum global concurrency, emergency full-fanout override for high-severity changes, and audit logs for compliance.

Success criteria / acceptance:
- Measurable reduction (>60%) in redundant eval runs for bursty pin activity from noisy model updates (measured in synthetic test).
- High-priority tenants (SLA score >=80) see preflight evals within 10 minutes 95% of the time.
- No increase in false-negative regressions vs current baseline (within 3% delta on known regression suite).
- End-to-end tracing available in Console for each pin->eval flow.

Non-goals: full eval sampling UI (PM will own), building new eval testsets (we will call existing harness), or changing model pin semantics across the catalog.
acceptance_criteria: Delta calculator returns numeric urgency score and human-readable reason for >95% of pins in integration tests
Coalescer window prevents more than one dispatched eval per (tenant, model) pair within the window when churn < threshold
Tenant reservoir honors monthly eval budget and deprioritizes non-critical tenants when budget exhausted
End-to-end trace appears in Console with links to the invoked eval job and corresponding PR/CI run when applicable
design_decisions: Delta scoring will be rule + feature-based initially (size, tokenizer-id, quantization-change, config-diff heuristics) with a follow-up ML ranker (separate ticket)
Coalescing window is configurable at infra level (default 5 minutes) to let rapid authoring workflows batch into one evaluation
Dispatch hint contains tenant_priority (0-100), urgency_score (0-1), estimated_eval_tokens to allow downstream cost-aware schedulers to bin-pack
We will implement the service as a small stateless microservice with Redis for short-lived dedupe keys and reservoir counters; avoids long-lived state in this iteration
implementation_notes: Proto: pin-event { tenant_id, catalog_model_id, pinned_version, prev_version, mutations[], timestamp, actor, source }
Delta calc will call model-metadata svc for model fingerprints and a light tokenizer/size estimator to detect hidden tokenization regressions
Coalescer flow: incoming events -> fingerprint check -> compute delta -> lookup tenant profile -> consult reservoir -> enqueue into eval-orchestrator via gRPC
Expose metrics: pin_events_total, deduped_events, dispatched_evals, avg_urgency, per_tenant_budget_remaining
Docs: Confluence page with flow diagram and config knobs (link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/EVAL/Pin+Delta+Coalescer)
test_plan: Unit tests for delta calculator with synthetic diffs (tokenizer id change, vocab shrink, quantization bit reduction)
Integration test simulating bursty pins across 200 tenants to measure dedupe ratio and dispatch latency
Staging smoke: hook to staging eval-orchestrator with canary tenant flags and observe end-to-end tracing
Chaos: simulate Redis flaps and ensure safe-fallback to conservative full-fanout if dedupe store unavailable
rollout_plan: Feature-flagged rollout in staging for 48h with traffic shadowing of production pin events
Enable in production for 10% of pin events (sampling by tenant hash) for 72h while monitoring dispatched_evals and eval-failures
Ramp to 100% if metrics stable; otherwise rollback and triage
Post-rollout: run a comparative regression evaluation on a withheld suite to confirm no regression in detection coverage
monitoring_and_alerting: SLOs: 95th percentile dispatch latency <= 10m for SLA-priority tenants
Alerts: sudden drop (>25%) in dispatched_evals for high-urgency pins, or reservoir exhaustion for >5% of tenants
Dashboards: per-tenant reservoir level, coalescing hit-rate, urgency distribution, and cost-savings estimate vs baseline
